# Back Road Ramblers

> > An outdoor travel blog by Tara and Eric featuring off-the-beaten-path adventures, hiking guides, and road trip itineraries across the United States and Vermont.

Back Road Ramblers is a travel blog focused on outdoor adventures, camping, hiking, and exploring lesser-known destinations. The site offers practical travel guides, partnership opportunities for outdoor brands, and authentic storytelling from experienced adventurers.
